title: WorldState
description:
The whole simulated world. Missing stores load empty, so adding a store keeps
older saves loadable.

counters.description: Activity counters that pace beats and unlocks (never clock time).

markets.description: One market per station that trades, keyed by station.

packs.description: Per installed pack: script stores, trigger counts, script health.

progress.description: Beats, progression rules, tunables and mechanic slots (W4).

ship_rules.description: Flight, mining, lane and control-tier tunables (`ship_rules.toml`).

talk.description: Dock talk, map notes and chronicle entries.

ActivityCounters.description: Read-only activity counters per player, station and region.

ActivityTally.description: Running activity at a station or region. Integers, so undo is exact.

pending_milli.description: Pulses counted but not yet applied to the market (thousandths).

pulses_milli.description: Pulses so far, in thousandths of a pulse.

BeatKind.description:
Directed beats are the authored backbone; situations (a shortage, a dispute, a
rumor) fire from world state and history. Both run the same way.

BeatState.description: Where a started beat is. Dormant beats have no state at all.

done_since.description: Facts after this one happened since the beat completed.

goal.description: The one goal line the HUD shows while the beat is active.

since.description:
Facts after this one happened since the beat started (`None`: from the start of
history). Beats order by facts, never by time.

started.description: The tick it started on, for ordering goal lines (newest first).

step.description:
The step under way, from 0. Equal to the number of steps once every step is
done and the beat waits on its end state.

step_id.description: The current step's ID, if the beat has steps and one is under way.

step_since.description: Facts after this one happened since the current step started.

BuildState.description: A station's visible growth: a stage number plus the kit parts attached.

CapabilityDef.description:
A control capability (`cap.click_fly`). The ship crate reads the same flag names
from `ship_rules.toml`.

tier.description: The presentation tier it belongs to.

oneOf.description: A line a person offers when the player docks where they are.
A note pinned to a place on the map.
An entry in the chronicle of the save. History: a rollback can't remove it.

queue.description: Shift held: append to the queue instead of replacing it.

Condition.description: A world condition. Evaluated by the engine against world state only.

oneOf.description: The line's current price, in centicredits, is at least `price`.
The line's current price, in centicredits, is at most `price`.

ControlRules.description:
Control tiers as progression. Each input mode is unlocked by a per-save flag
(`Player::flags`); the flag names are data.

automation.description: The player's automated craft may run saved loops.

click_dock.description: Click a station: fly into the ring and dock.

click_fly.description: Click a point near the ship: fly there and stop.

click_fly_range.description: How far from the ship a click-to-fly point may be (map travel has no limit).

click_mine.description: Click a rock: fly into reach and mine.

loop_limit.description: Most orders in a saved loop.

loops.description: Save a queue as a named loop and run it.

map_travel.description: Click anything on the map, any distance, routing through lanes.

queues.description: Shift-click appends orders to a queue.

CounterKind.description: Activity counters. Pacing reads these, never a clock.

oneOf.description: Sales and deliveries, one per transaction.
Handovers to a ledger (goal deliveries, station growth, dispute tallies).

CraftDef.description: An automated craft a station builds for the player (a tender).

DeedFilter.description: Which facts a deed counts. Each field narrows; a list matches any of its values.

any_ship.description: Count any ship's facts, not just the player's.

others.description: Matches the fact's `other` subject (a ledger, a beat ...).

DeedRule.description: A faction's memory rule: a deed the player does moves standing.

cap_per_docking.description: Most steps per docking (counted from the player's latest docking).

on.description: The facts that count. `ship` defaults to the player's ship.

per.description: Units (summed `amount`) per step; without it every matching fact is a step.

DockTrack.description: A ship's last docking, for the counted-docking rule.

away.description: It has since gone far enough or mined, so docking here again counts.

approach.description:
A dock order steers until the ship is this far into the ring (share of its
radius from the centre), then docks.

EconomyRules.description: The market's tunables. Also the schema of a pack's `data/economy.toml`.

EconomyState.description: Economy data and running tallies, saved with the world.

docks.description: Per ship: where it last docked, for the counted-docking rule.

rules.description: From the pack's `economy.toml` at new game.

Event.description: Something that happened, with stable IDs.

oneOf.description: Units moved from a rock into a hold.

unit_price.description: The average unit price, in centicredits.
The average unit price, in centicredits.

oneOf.description: Cargo handed over for a goal or a station's growth, not sold.

ledger.description: The delivery tally it counts toward (also the fact's `other` subject).

oneOf.description: A price snapshot was taken at a station.
A beat's next step started (`quest` is the beat's ID).

deed_count.description: How many times the deed had been done.

oneOf.description: A play session began (the app emits it when the game starts).
A beat's preconditions held and it started.
A control capability flag was set for the first time.
A deed moved the player's standing. The number is never shown.
The player's regard tier with a faction changed (tier IDs).
A station built the player an automated craft.

The PAUSED card opened. The app submits it every time the card opens; the sim
doesn't tick while paused, so it commits on the first tick after the card
closes. `session` is the `sessions` counter of the play session it happened in.

EventEnvelope.description: An emitted event as subscribers see it.

fact.description: The history fact recorded for this event; cite it.

claims.description: Stations it claims but may not hold.

mark.description: Its mark, in a few words.

standing.description: The player's standing. Shown through how people treat you, not a bar.

FlightRules.description: Arcade flight feel. Ships stop when nothing pushes them: there is no coasting.

accel_time.description: Seconds from rest to top speed, for hulls without their own `accel`.

arrive_distance.description: A fly order is done within this many world units of its point.

brake.description: Braking is this many times stronger than accelerating, so release stops fast.

turn_rate.description: Degrees per second, for hulls without their own `turn_rate`.

turn_slowdown.description:
Share of top speed lost while moving directly away from the heading (0..=1).
The ship swings round to face where it goes, and turn rate shapes the feel.

oneOf.description: Travel to another region along lanes.

HandlerRetry.description:
An event handler call to run again because its writes lost to contention: a valid
write the projection rejected only because the world changed earlier in the tick.

lost.description: Times the call has lost so far (the first run included).

HistoryQuery.description: A history filter. Empty matches everything. `count`, `find` and `last` take one.

after.description: Facts with an ID greater than this (for paging).

since.description: Facts at or after this tick.

until.description: Facts at or before this tick.

Hull.description: A hull class. Provisional numbers live in the core pack's `hulls.toml`.

accel.description: World units per second squared. Missing: top speed in `flight.accel_time`.

max_speed.description: World units per second at nominal tick rate.

mining_rate.description: Mining units per second at nominal tick rate.

price_reach.description: How far the hull sees live market prices. Default: docked only.

standing_berth.description:
Docking rings give this hull a standing berth, so it may wait docked for a
price (the tender's patient sell). Crewed hulls trade and clear the ring.

HullRecord.description: What the player did in one hull. Kept for every hull they've flown.

berthed_as.description: Where the hull is kept now that the player flies another.

since.description: Facts after this one count toward its ranks (`None`: all of history).

until.description: Set when the player left the hull at prestige; its ranks are frozen.

Lane.description: A lane between two regions. Gates are world positions at each end.

LaneRules.description: Lanes are currents: every hull rides them at the same speed and can't steer.

mouth_radius.description: A ship within this distance of a lane mouth can enter the lane.

speed.description: World units per second inside a lane.

Market.description: A station market as plain data. W3 (economy) owns the maths that moves it.

MarketLine.description:
One ware at one market. W3 (`galaxy-economy`) prices it; see
[`PricingRules`](crate::economy::PricingRules) for the formula.

base_price.description: Where the price settles with no pressure.

consumption.description: Units the station uses per station pulse.

needs.description: Production runs only while each of these wares is in stock here.

price.description:
The current unit price in centicredits: what the station pays for a `buys`
line, what it asks for a `sells` line. Kept up to date by the economy. Every
price here is in centicredits ([`crate::money`]).

production.description: Units the station makes per station pulse (activity, never a clock).

sat_per_unit.description: Saturation added per unit sold to the station.

saturation.description: 0 (fresh) up to the rules' `saturation_max`. Only `buys` lines saturate.

stock_carry.description: The fraction of a unit produced or used but not yet whole, in 0..1.

target.description:
The stock the station aims for; prices rise below it and fall above it. Zero:
stock doesn't move the price.

MarketRole.description:
Whether a station buys a ware from ships or sells it to them. A station never
buys a ware it produces, or sells one it consumes.

oneOf.description: The station buys it (pays a price that saturation lowers).
The station sells it (asks a price with a spread).

Measure.description: How many times a deed was done.

oneOf.description: An activity counter (player scope unless a station or region is given).
Matching history facts.
The `amount`s of matching facts.

radius_base.description: A rock's radius is `radius_base + radius_per_sqrt_unit * sqrt(remaining)`.

reach.description: A ship mines while within this distance of a rock's edge.

mined.description: Units moved into the hold so far in this run.

progress.description: Fractional units cut but not yet in the hold.

Modifier.description:
The fixed list of native effects traits, fittings and ranks may have. Each is
small and qualitative; `galaxy-progress` adds them up per ship and the ship,
economy and app crates read the totals.

oneOf.description: Multiplies mining rate (the mining lens: 1.5).
Mining while facing a rock's richest face yields this much more (Rimesight).
Extra hold units (hold extender, Wren rank 2).
Extra hold units on each of the player's tenders (Tandem rank 3).
Multiplies turn rate.
Multiplies top speed.
Multiplies docking ring reach (Ringwise: 1.25).
Lane mouths catch the ship from this radius (Lanerunner: 105).
Live prices of stations within this distance (price glass: 1200).
Multiplies standing gains from deeds with this tag (Good neighbour: delivery x1.5).

A named presentation feature for the app and talk (`sell_preview`,
`last_visit_greeting`, `lane_radio`, `rumor_first`, `seam_sense` ...).

Num.description: A number, or the current value of a tunable.

oneOf.description: Mine until the hold is full or the rock is depleted.

floor.description:
Sell only while the unit price, in centicredits, is at or above this. A crewed
ship then keeps the rest; a hull with a standing berth waits docked for the
price (patient sell).

oneOf.description: Wait until a world condition holds (e.g. a price recovers above a floor).
Repeat `orders` until `until` holds, or forever.

OrderProgress.description: Where a ship is inside its current order, beyond `OrderQueue::current`.

blocked.description:
A patient sell's floor is above what the station can pay now (its ceiling): it
waits docked, keeps its cargo and its floor, until the ceiling is back.

credits.description: Centicredits the current buy or sell has moved so far.

lap_end.description:
A lap has just ended: the loop's `until` is checked against the world as the
lap left it, before the next lap starts.

lap_moved.description: This lap moved cargo or credits. A lap that moves nothing stalls the loop.

laps.description: Laps of the current loop completed.

step.description: The order being run inside a `loop` order.

traded.description: Units the current buy or sell has moved so far.

waiting.description:
A patient sell is waiting in a standing berth for its floor, since its region
had this many pulses.

OrderQueue.description: A ship's orders and where it is in them.

current.description: Index of the order being executed.

progress.description: Progress inside the current order (loop step, laps, patient sell).

Owner.description:
Who owns a ship. Player-owned ships (flagship and automated craft) feed the
player's activity counters.

PackState.description:
What a world keeps for one installed pack. Scripts hold no state in Luau; this is
where anything they remember lives, so a reload or a save loses nothing.

health.description: Aborted handler calls and quarantine, per script.

retired.description: Revisions switched off by a rollback. Their handlers don't run.

stores.description: Declared stores: script -> store -> key -> value.

Player.description: The player: wallet, flagship, unlocks and what they know.

fittings.description: Upgrades fitted. They belong to the pilot and move to a new hull (W4).

flags.description: Per-save mechanic flags: control unlocks, script switches.

hull_records.description: Ranks and rank windows for every hull the player has flown (W4).

loops.description: Saved loops by the player's name for them: the orders a loop repeats.

price_snapshots.description: Scouted prices, dated by the visit they were taken on.

ship.description: The ship the player flies by hand.

berth_as.description: The old hull stays berthed at the station as this ship.

PrestigeRules.description: Hullwright prestige: trade the hull up for a fee. Only hull ranks reset.

requires.description: When the offer appears (beyond being docked at `station` with the fee).

PriceReach.description: How far a hull sees live prices. The default is "docked only".

lane_scout.description: A lane arrival refreshes the snapshots of every station in the new region.

radius.description: Live prices of stations within this distance. Zero: docked only.

region.description: Live prices of every station in the ship's region.

PriceSnapshot.description: What the player saw at a station's market on their last visit.

visit.description: The player's docking count when it was taken: "dated by your last visit".

PricingRules.description:
The price formula's numbers.

```text
stock_factor = clamp(1 + stock_slope * (1 - stock / target), stock_factor_min, stock_factor_max)
pays = base * stock_factor * (1 - saturation)
asks = base * stock_factor * spread
```

flood_saturation.description: A sale that leaves saturation at or above this records a `market_flooded` fact.

produce_cap.description: Producers stop at `target * produce_cap`. Zero means no cap.

regard.description:
Spread by the player's standing with the station's owner. The last tier whose
`min_standing` is at or below the standing applies.

spread.description: Asking-price spread at stations with no owner, or when no regard tier applies.

ProgressRules.description: The progression tables. Money is centicredits.

crafts.description: Craft the player can have built (the tenders).

profile.description: The pacing profile the tunables came from (`slice`).

ranks.description: Hull ranks, in hull then rank order.

standing_min.description: Standing is clamped to this range.

ProgressState.description: Everything W4 keeps in the world. Missing parts load empty.

beats.description: Beats that have started, by stable ID. A beat with no entry is dormant.

rules.description:
The progression tables from the core pack's data (upgrades, controls, traits,
ranks, regard, deeds, prestige). Saved with the world.

slots.description: Reserved input and UI slots, bound to the mechanic that uses them.

tunables.description: Pacing numbers and choices beats read (`pacing.toml`).

PulseRules.description: How much market activity each kind of event makes.

arrival_stations.description: Station pulse at every station in the region a ship arrives in by lane.

dock_neighbours.description: Station pulse at every other station in that region.

dock_station.description: Station pulse at the station a ship docks at (counted dockings only).

recount_distance.description:
A re-docking at the same station counts only after the ship has been at least
this far from it, mined, or docked somewhere else. Stops undock-redock loops.

oneOf.description: Everything in the hold (sell) or everything affordable that fits (buy).

RankDef.description: A hull rank: deeds done in that hull. Ranks are what prestige resets.

deed.description:
Counted only over facts since the player started flying this hull. Use
`facts` or `sum` measures on `ship.player`.

ReachRules.description: Price reach granted by player flags (fitted upgrades such as the price glass).

flags.description: Flag -> live prices for stations within this many world units of the ship.

RegardTier.description: A regard tier: how people treat you at a standing. The number stays hidden.

shows.description: How it shows, in one line.

RegrowthRules.description: How rocks regrow. Driven by activity counters in the field's region, never by time.

pulses.description: Region counters that make up a region's activity ("region pulses"), with weights.

reform_share.description:
A spent rock reforms (can be mined again) once regrowth has brought it back to
this share of its full yield. Reforming adds no units of its own.

Requirement.description:
A condition over world state, history and activity counters. Never time: there is
no clock to name. Used by beats, upgrade unlocks and prestige.

oneOf.description: Always holds.
Started and not completed.
The beat has reached at least this step (0 = its first step is under way).
An activity counter for the player, a station or a region.
At least `at_least` history facts match (default 1).
The `amount`s of matching facts add up to at least `at_least`.
The player's ship is this hull.
The player owns this craft.
Credits, in centicredits.
Units of a ware in the player ship's hold.
Free room in the player ship's hold.
The player ship is docked at this station.
The player ship is docked anywhere.
The player ship is in this region.
The player's regard with a faction is at least this tier (by tier ID).
A tunable holds this value.

A Luau predicate a script registered with `G.test` (by index within its
script). Data files can't hold one.

initial.description: Units when generated; `remaining / initial` drives the visible shrink.

RockField.description:
An authored field. Rocks are generated from it once, at new game, with stable IDs
`<rock_prefix>.01`, `<rock_prefix>.02`, ...

regrow.description:
Units the whole field regrows per region pulse, each pulse's units going to the
rock with the lowest remaining share (spent rocks included). Region pulses are
activity (`ship_rules.regrowth.pulses`), never time. Kept in thousandths.

rock_prefix.description: Prefix for generated rock IDs, e.g. `rock.shallows.ice`.

RockGrowth.description: A rock's regrowth bookkeeping, in region activity (pulses), never time.

mark.description: The region activity its field's regrowth has accounted for.

milli.description:
Regrown thousandths of a unit not yet in `remaining`. A spent rock keeps all of
its regrowth here until it reaches the reform share, then reforms with it.

hardness.description: Multiplier on a hull's mining rate (1.0 = soft ice, lower = slower to cut).

regrowth.description: Units regrown per regrowth step (W2 defines the step from activity, never a clock).

Rumor.description: A rumor with a truth value. It may be true, or planted.

claim.description: What it claims, in one line.

planted_by.description: Who planted it, if it's a plant.

source.description: The fact it grew from, if any.

SaidLine.description: A line as the world keeps it.

ScriptHealth.description: How a script's current revision has behaved.

quarantined_before.description:
Earlier revisions of this script that were quarantined. Loading one of them
again doesn't give it a clean start: it stays quarantined.

retries.description:
Event handler calls that lost to contention and run again next tick, oldest
first. Kept across a new revision: the event still happened.

revision.description: The revision these counts are for; a new revision starts clean.

ScriptValue.description: A value in a script store.

Service.description: What a station offers when docked.

activity.description: Lane transit, mining run and input edge state.

orders.description: The ship's order queue (same verbs for player, automated and NPC craft).

ShipActivity.description: What a ship is in the middle of, beyond its motion and orders.

action_held.description:
The context action was held last tick. A press docks, undocks or enters a lane
once; holding keeps mining.

held_clicks.description:
The player's clicks from ticks whose batch hasn't committed yet, oldest first.
They're written ahead of the tick's batch, cleared by it, and replayed next tick
if it was rejected, so a click is never lost to a mine or trade that lost.

held_press.description: Likewise for a press of the context action.

mining.description: The mining run under way: one `mine` event when it ends.

ShipRules.description:
Tunables for ships, mining, lanes and control tiers. Saved with the world, so a
save keeps the rules it was played with until something changes them.

Since.description: Which facts a history requirement counts.

oneOf.description: The whole history.
Since the beat started (for beat requirements).
Since the current step started.

SlotDef.description: A reserved input or UI slot, free until a taught mechanic binds it.

dock_radius.description: Ships within this distance of `position` can dock.

TalkLine.description: One line of text in the world.

about.description: Changes this line is about, e.g. the causes a rollback undid.

cites.description: The facts this line is about. Never empty.

place.description: Where it is said, or what place it is about.

TalkLog.description: Every line said in this save, by ID.

last.description: The last line's sequence number (0 before the first).

Tick.description: Simulation tick count (30 per second nominal; the sim never reads a clock).

TraitDef.description: A pilot trait: earned by doing one deed many times, kept for good (prestige too).

times.description: How many times. Never shown as a bar or a count.

Transit.description: A lane transit: straight from `start` to `end` at the lane speed.

Tunable.description:
A pacing number or choice. `authored` is what the pack data says; a script may
change `value` with a cause, and a rollback restores it.

set_by.description: The pack whose script last changed it (`None`: the pack data's value).

UpgradeDef.description: A fitting a station sells. Fittings are never removed and move with the pilot.

effect.description: One line for the seller's list.

station.description: Where it's fitted. `None`: only as a beat reward.

unlock.description: When it appears on the seller's list.

Vec2.description: A point or vector on the sim plane.

VerbKind.description: Verb names, used in causes and `order_done` events.

tradeable.description: False for things that can't be bought or sold (the Ancients fragment).

seed.description: The new-game seed. Subsystem random generators derive from it.
